newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa, Stet best offer for Spain Retevision - press.
newsitem.headline: Endesa, Stet best offer for Spain Retevision - press.

text.p: The group formed by the Spanish state-owned eletricity firm Endesa and Italy's Stet has made the highest offer for the 60 pct of Retevision on sale, proposing to pay 115 billion pesetas, local financial newspaper Expansion reported on Tuesday.
The OPERA group, its contender in the privatisation of Retevision, which will soon become Spain's second domestic telephone operator, offered around 82 billion pesetas, the paper added.
No-one was immediately avaliable to confirm the details. Retevision is expected to detail offers later today.
Although four groups with a range of foreign and Spanish partners initially expressed interest in the Retevision stake, only two handed in bids by the Monday deadline.
The Opera group is made up of Spanish bank BCH, France Telecom and U.S. operator Sprint.
